"""Finite offline relay, explicit full-block admission and unconditional reports."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,os,signal,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3];HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=ROOT/'stage/runs/t660_joint_night_relay';DOC=ROOT/'stage/docs/overnight_20261119'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'stage/experiments/t645_iterative_recovery_relay'));import control as Resource

def read(f):return json.loads(Path(f).read_text())
def sha(f):return hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(f,v):
    Path(f).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);Path(f).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
def used(f):return sum(x.stat().st_size for x in Path(f).rglob('*') if x.is_file())

def call(action,name,seconds,children):
    with (OUT/name/(action+'.log')).open('xb') as log:
        c=subprocess.Popen([str(ROOT/'run_stage.sh'),str(HERE/'runtime.py'),action,name],cwd=ROOT,
            stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True,env=dict(os.environ,CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='',CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8'))
        children.append(c.pid)
        save(OUT/'status.json',dict(state='ACTIVE',child=name,action=action,child_pid=c.pid,driver_pid=os.getpid(),epoch=time.time()))
        try:c.wait(timeout=seconds);assert c.returncode==0,(action,name,c.returncode)
        except BaseException:
            try:os.killpg(c.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            except ProcessLookupError:pass
            try:c.wait(timeout=3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(c.pid,signal.SIGKILL);c.wait()
            raise

def main():
    p=read(OUT/'protocol.json');assert p['authorization_approved'] and sha(HERE/'protocol.json')==sha(OUT/'protocol.json')
    assert not (OUT/'DRIVER_STARTED.json').exists()
    for f,h in p['inputs'].items():assert sha(f)==h,f
    receipt=read(ROOT/'stage/runs/t224_archive/latest_source_sync_receipt.json')
    assert receipt['root_tree']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
    Resource.resources();os.sched_setaffinity(0,{14})
    save(OUT/'DRIVER_STARTED.json',dict(pid=os.getpid(),epoch=time.time(),source_remote=receipt['remote_commit'],science_network=False))
    log=(OUT/'affinity.log').open('xb');helper=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/python3',str(HERE/'affinity_guard.py')],cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=log)
    children=[];results=[];error=None;best=None
    ledger=dict(physics=0,commands=0,main_seconds=0.,Actor_live=0,Value_live=0,children=[],denied=[])
    def child(name,template,**kw):
        nonlocal best
        Resource.resources();assert helper.poll() is None
        c=dict(p,**template,**kw);c['out']=str(OUT/name);c['arm']=kw.get('arm',template['arm'])
        learning=c['kind']=='learn';now=time.time()
        okay=(ledger['physics']+c['max_physics']<=p['night_max_physics'] and
            ledger['commands']+c['max_commands']<=p['night_max_commands'] and
            ledger['main_seconds']+c['main_seconds']<=p['night_main_seconds'] and
            ledger['Actor_live']+c['actor_cap']<=p['Actor_each_cap'] and ledger['Value_live']+c['value_cap']<=p['Value_each_cap'] and
            used(OUT)+c['child_bytes']+p['final_storage_reserve']<=p['max_bytes'] and
            now+c['main_seconds']<p['absolute_native_stop'] and
            now+c['main_seconds']+c['audit_seconds']+p['finalization_seconds']<p['absolute_all_stop'] and
            (not learning or now+c['learning_seconds']+c['block_science_reserve_seconds']<p['absolute_learning_stop']))
        if not okay:
            ledger['denied'].append(dict(name=name,reason='FULL_WORST_TIME_COMPUTE_STORAGE_ADMISSION_DENIED',epoch=now));save(OUT/'LEDGER.json',ledger);return None
        folder=OUT/name;folder.mkdir();(folder/'episodes').mkdir();(DOC/name).mkdir()
        c['_root_sha256']=sha(OUT/'protocol.json');save(folder/'protocol.json',{k:v for k,v in c.items() if k not in p or p[k]!=v})
        started=time.time();science_end=None;summary=None;audit=None
        try:
            call('main' if learning else 'frozen_main',name,c['main_seconds'],children);science_end=time.time()
            summary=read(folder/'summary.json');call('audit' if learning else 'frozen_audit',name,c['audit_seconds'],children)
            audit=read(folder/'audit.json');assert audit['state']=='PASS'
        finally:
            if summary is None and (folder/'summary.json').exists():summary=read(folder/'summary.json')
            actual=dict(name=name,kind=c['kind'],state=summary['state'] if summary else 'FAILED_NO_SUMMARY',audit=audit,
                physics=summary['physics'] if summary else c['max_physics'],commands=summary['commands'] if summary else c['max_commands'],
                main_seconds=(science_end or time.time())-started,
                Actor_live=summary.get('live_Actor',0) if summary else c['actor_cap'],
                Value_live=summary.get('live_Value',0) if summary else c['value_cap'],counts_exact=summary is not None)
            results.append(actual)
            for key in ['physics','commands','main_seconds','Actor_live','Value_live']:ledger[key]+=actual[key]
            ledger['children'].append(actual);save(OUT/'LEDGER.json',ledger)
        assert summary['state']=='COMPLETE'
        for generation in read(folder/'worker_generations.json') if (folder/'worker_generations.json').exists() else []:
            ids=[generation['parent'],*generation['workers']];assert all(not Path('/proc',str(pid)).exists() for pid in ids);children.extend(ids)
        assert ledger['physics']<=p['night_max_physics'] and ledger['commands']<=p['night_max_commands']
        assert ledger['Actor_live']<=p['Actor_each_cap'] and ledger['Value_live']<=p['Value_each_cap']
        save(folder/'local_manifest.json',dict(files=[dict(path=str(f.relative_to(ROOT)),bytes=f.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(f))
            for f in sorted(folder.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and f.name!='local_manifest.json']))
        if learning and summary.get('best'):
            b=summary['best']
            if best is None or b['full407']['success']>best['full407']['success']:best=b
        return summary
    try:
        until=time.time()+5
        while not (DOC/'AFFINITY_GUARD.json').exists() and time.time()<until:
            assert helper.poll() is None;time.sleep(.05)
        assert read(DOC/'AFFINITY_GUARD.json')['pid']==helper.pid
        # Every science branch is independent from original T501. Scientific
        # rejection advances this list; contracts/errors abort the root.
        for index,arm in enumerate(p['arms']):
            template=p['bc_template'] if arm.startswith('bc') else p['rl_template']
            child(arm,template,arm=arm,arm_index=index)
        # Full original-start profiles are deterministic development measures.
        models=[('baseline',p['initial'])]+([] if best is None else [('best',best['model'])])
        for label,model in models:
            child('full407_'+label,p['profile_template'],initial=model,frozen_jobs=p['evaluation_jobs'],frozen_seeds=None,frozen_full=False)
        # Finite round-robin 19 unresolved fields, not seed/window search.
        # Fixed baseline coverage is useful even when all learning branches
        # reject; original raw successes AND failures are retained offline.
        for batch in range(p['coverage_batches']):
            jobs=[j for j in p['coverage_jobs'] for unused in range(p['coverage_replicates_per_batch'])]
            seeds=[[p['night_seed'],900,batch,i] for i in range(len(jobs))]
            if child(f'coverage_{batch:02d}',p['coverage_template'],initial=p['initial'],frozen_jobs=jobs,frozen_seeds=seeds,frozen_full=True) is None:break
    except BaseException:error=traceback.format_exc();save(OUT/'failure.json',dict(error=error,no_restart=True,raw_preserved=True))
    for f in OUT.glob('*/worker_generations.json'):
        for g in read(f):children.extend([g['parent'],*g['workers']])
    ids=sorted(set(children));gone=all(not Path('/proc',str(pid)).exists() for pid in ids)
    save(OUT/'SEALED.json',dict(all_scientific_processes_stopped=gone,scientific_pids=ids,epoch=time.time()))
    (OUT/'AFFINITY_STOP').touch()
    try:helper.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:helper.terminate();helper.wait(timeout=3)
    log.close()
    report=dict(state='FAILED' if error else 'COMPLETE_FINITE_QUEUE_OR_BUDGET_STOP',error=error,ledger=ledger,best=best,
                all_scientific_processes_stopped=gone,remote='REMOTE_PENDING_LOCAL_OFFLINE_RAW_RETAINED',
                no_unseen_layout_or_universal_nonforgetting_claim=True,epoch=time.time())
    save(OUT/'FINAL_REPORT.json',report);save(DOC/'FINAL_REPORT.json',report)
    if gone and time.time()+p['backup_seconds']+p['source_seconds']+30<p['absolute_all_stop']:
        try:
            with (OUT/'backup.log').open('xb') as log:
                c=subprocess.run([str(ROOT/'run_stage.sh'),str(HERE/'transport.py')],cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    timeout=p['backup_seconds'],env=dict(os.environ,CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''))
            assert c.returncode==0;report['remote']='FULL_REMOTE_READBACK_AND_EVERY_MEMBER_SHA_VERIFIED'
        except BaseException:report['backup_error']=traceback.format_exc()
    save(OUT/'FINAL_REPORT_FINAL.json',report);save(DOC/'FINAL_REPORT.json',report)
    save(OUT/'status.json',dict(state=report['state'],all_science_stopped=gone,epoch=time.time()))
    status=ROOT/'stage/docs/RESEARCH_STATUS.md';status.write_text('2026-11-20 T660离线联合学习多支线结束：'+report['state']+'，remote='+report['remote']+
        '；真实branch/round/384保持与387目标/条件407及覆盖数据见overnight_20261119/FINAL_REPORT，缺测null，非普遍抗遗忘或真机通过。\n\n'+status.read_text())
    if gone:
        try:
            paths=[str(DOC.relative_to(ROOT)),'stage/docs/RESEARCH_STATUS.md']
            paths.extend(str(f.relative_to(ROOT)) for f in (ROOT/'stage/docs/long_distance_20261101').glob('*T660*.json'))
            subprocess.run(['git','add','--',*paths],cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True)
            subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','Report bounded offline joint learning overnight relay'],cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True)
            if time.time()+p['source_seconds']+10<p['absolute_all_stop']:
                # Execute outside generic runtime imports to avoid transport
                # module-name cache collisions in the evidence exporter.
                subprocess.run([str(ROOT/'run_stage.sh'),str(ROOT/'stage/experiments/t629_offline_night_relay/t629_transport.py'),'source_sync'],
                    cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=p['source_seconds'],env=dict(os.environ,CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''))
        except BaseException:save(DOC/'SOURCE_PENDING.json',dict(error=traceback.format_exc()))
    print(json.dumps(dict(state=report['state'],best=best,ledger=ledger,remote=report['remote'])),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Resource-only fallback when user systemd cpuset controller is unavailable.

Never edits scientific modules, protocols, raw arrays or model parameters.
Targets only threads already belonging to this exact Stage cgroup.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,sys,time
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT=ROOT/'stage/runs/t660_joint_night_relay'
DOC=ROOT/'stage/docs/overnight_20261119'
CG=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-1000.slice/user@1000.service/app.slice/stage-t660.service')
SAFE={8,10,12,14}

def configuration(folder=OUT):
    p=json.loads((folder/'protocol.json').read_text())
    assert p['out']==str(OUT)
    return p,folder/'DRIVER_STARTED.json',folder/'AFFINITY_STOP'

def main():
    p,driver_file,stop_file=configuration()
    driver=json.loads(driver_file.read_text())['pid']
    os.sched_setaffinity(0,{14})
    # Membership makes all helper work count against the existing 400% CPU
    # quota, 4GiB RAM limit and absolute external cgroup kill deadline.
    (CG/'cgroup.procs').write_text(str(os.getpid()))
    start=time.time();changes=0
    receipt=dict(state='ACTIVE_RESOURCE_ONLY',pid=os.getpid(),driver=driver,cgroup=str(CG),safe_cpus=sorted(SAFE),
        reason='systemd EffectiveCPUs empty; Mesa disk helper thread widened its affinity',
        source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),new_native=0,new_optimizer=0,epoch=start)
    (DOC/'AFFINITY_GUARD.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    while time.time()<p['absolute_all_stop'] and Path('/proc',str(driver)).exists() and not stop_file.exists():
        for pid in (CG/'cgroup.procs').read_text().split():
            try:threads=list(Path('/proc',pid,'task').iterdir())
            except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError):continue
            for thread in threads:
                try:
                    tid=int(thread.name);mask=os.sched_getaffinity(tid)
                    if not mask<=SAFE:
                        os.sched_setaffinity(tid,mask&SAFE or {14});changes+=1
                except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError):pass
        time.sleep(.5)
    receipt.update(state='ENDED',changes=changes,ended=time.time())
    (DOC/'AFFINITY_GUARD.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import copy,ast,gzip,json,hashlib,sys,importlib.util,os
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3];HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DOC=ROOT/'stage/docs/overnight_20261119';OUT=ROOT/'stage/runs/t660_joint_night_relay'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'stage/experiments/t645_iterative_recovery_relay'));import control as Resource

def main():
    Resource.resources()
    import runtime as T
    M,R,torch,np=T.M,T.R,T.torch,T.np
    assert not OUT.exists();DOC.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p=T.read(ROOT/'stage/runs/t656_qualified_recovery_pg/protocol.json')
    oldp=copy.deepcopy(p);initial=p['safe_retained'];contract=ROOT/'stage/docs/day_20261119/innovation_reset/UNIQUE_387_REFERENCE_CONTRACT.json'
    refs=T.read(contract);assert len(refs['reference_rows'])==387
    fixed_ids=['dev_task6_00','dev_task6_02','dev_task6_03','dev_task6_26','dev_task3_00','dev_task7_13','wide117_80_dev6_LEFT_18','wide117_8m_dev6_RIGHT_18']
    jobs={j['id']:j for j in p['evaluation_jobs']};training=p['field_jobs']+[jobs[key] for key in fixed_ids];assert len(training)==32
    allstop=datetime(2026,11,20,9,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).timestamp()
    learning=datetime(2026,11,20,7,30,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).timestamp()
    native_stop=datetime(2026,11,20,8,15,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).timestamp()
    p.update(id='T660_OFFLINE_JOINT_LEARNING_NIGHT',out=str(OUT),authorization_approved=False,initial=initial,
        reference_contract=str(contract),required387_ids=refs['required_success_ids'],training_jobs=training,
        original_screen_success_ids=sorted(set(p['before_success_ids'])&{j['id'] for j in p['screen_jobs']}),
        key_ids=[j['id'] for j in p['key_jobs']],arms=['bc_mean','bc_tail','ppo_mean','ppo_tail'],
        night_max_physics=240000000,night_max_commands=6500,night_main_seconds=40000,
        Actor_each_cap=1072,Value_each_cap=192,max_bytes=7*2**30,global_bytes=10*2**30,
        final_storage_reserve=32*2**20,absolute_all_stop=allstop,absolute_native_stop=native_stop,absolute_learning_stop=learning,
        backup_seconds=1800,source_seconds=240,finalization_seconds=2400,
        fit_lr=3e-5,baseline_lr=3e-4,baseline_seed=20261119660,night_seed=202611196600,
        episodes_per_task=2,bc_steps=128,ppo_epochs=4,value_steps=16,replay_weight=10.,score_scale=512.,ratio_clip=.2,
        max_task_latent_KL=.01,model_bytes=4*2**20,state_bytes=4*2**20,coverage_batches=32,coverage_replicates_per_batch=2,
        user_authorization='Deadline09:00confirmed; independent night compute and optimizer budget pending explicit approval')
    for key in ['registration_epoch','_root_sha256','combined_physics_cap','combined_command_cap','combined_main_cap',
                'combined_storage_cap','prior_physics','prior_commands','prior_main_seconds','recovery_jobs','original_jobs',
                'field_train_jobs','field_keep_rows','existing_field_full_rows','field_reconstruct_jobs','field_reconstruct_references',
                'reuse_rows','training_rows','reference_by_id','memory_sources','reconstruction_references','profile_jobs',
                'initial_corrections','target_reference','recovery_row','new_teacher','new_RL','Actor_each_cap_old']:
        p.pop(key,None)
    oldset=set(p['before_success_ids']);assert len(oldset)==384
    coverage=[j for j in p['field_jobs'] if j['id'] not in oldset];assert len(coverage)==19
    p['coverage_jobs']=coverage
    screen_cap=sum(j['case']['step_cap'] for j in p['screen_jobs']);key_cap=sum(j['case']['step_cap'] for j in p['key_jobs'])
    rest_cap=sum(j['case']['step_cap'] for j in p['evaluation_jobs'] if j['id'] not in {q['id'] for q in p['screen_jobs']})
    train_cap=4*sum(j['case']['step_cap'] for j in training)
    p['bc_template']=dict(kind='learn',arm='bc_mean',rounds=4,actor_cap=512,value_cap=0,main_seconds=3600,audit_seconds=1200,
        learning_seconds=600,block_science_reserve_seconds=700,full_evaluation_reserve_seconds=1800,
        max_physics=4*(screen_cap+key_cap)+rest_cap,max_commands=4*56+371+6+6*3,child_bytes=384*2**20)
    p['rl_template']=dict(kind='learn',arm='ppo_mean',rounds=6,actor_cap=24,value_cap=96,main_seconds=14400,audit_seconds=1800,
        learning_seconds=300,block_science_reserve_seconds=2400,full_evaluation_reserve_seconds=1800,
        max_physics=6*(train_cap+screen_cap+key_cap)+rest_cap,max_commands=6*(128+56)+371+6+6*11,child_bytes=2*2**30)
    profile_cap=2*sum(j['case']['step_cap'] for j in p['evaluation_jobs'])
    p['profile_template']=dict(kind='profile',arm='profile',actor_cap=0,value_cap=0,main_seconds=3600,audit_seconds=600,
        max_physics=profile_cap,max_commands=820,child_bytes=64*2**20)
    coverage_cap=4*sum(j['case']['step_cap'] for j in coverage)
    p['coverage_template']=dict(kind='coverage',arm='coverage',actor_cap=0,value_cap=0,main_seconds=2400,audit_seconds=600,
        max_physics=coverage_cap,max_commands=82,child_bytes=160*2**20)
    for template in [p['bc_template'],p['rl_template'],p['profile_template'],p['coverage_template']]:
        template.update(max_bytes=template['child_bytes'],fresh_bytes=3*2**20,compact_bytes=32768,full_bytes=4*2**20)
    assert p['bc_template']['actor_cap']*2+p['rl_template']['actor_cap']*2==p['Actor_each_cap']
    assert 2*p['rl_template']['value_cap']==p['Value_each_cap']
    assert R.used(ROOT/'stage/runs')+p['max_bytes']<p['global_bytes']
    # Zero-update real GPU gradient and exact cached recurrent equivalence.
    R.B.setup(p);R.gpu_guard();os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']='0';os.environ['CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG']=':4096:8'
    obj=M.make(p,'cuda');q,v,ao,vo=obj;before=M.cpu_state(obj);qhash=q.phash()
    data=M.references(p,q,lambda:None);assert len(data)==387;packed=M.pack(data)
    reports={}
    for tail in [False,True]:
        ao.zero_grad(set_to_none=True);loss,losses=M.retention(q,packed,tail);loss.backward()
        grad=float(sum(x.grad.square().sum() for x in q.parameters() if x.requires_grad).sqrt())
        assert grad>0 and torch.isfinite(loss) and all(torch.isfinite(x.grad).all() for x in q.parameters() if x.requires_grad)
        reports['tail' if tail else 'mean']=dict(loss=float(loss.detach()),gradient_norm=grad)
    # Previous-block Value is initially exactly0; fitting is not performed.
    assert v(packed['f']).abs().max()==0 and not ao.state and not vo.state and digest_before(M,before,obj)
    with torch.no_grad():
        q.steer_adapter[-1].bias.add_(.01)
        for param in [x for x in q.parameters() if x.requires_grad]:ao.state[param]=dict(step=torch.tensor(7.),exp_avg=torch.full_like(param,.03),exp_avg_sq=torch.full_like(param,.06))
        for param in v.parameters():vo.state[param]=dict(step=torch.tensor(9.),exp_avg=torch.full_like(param,.02),exp_avg_sq=torch.full_like(param,.04))
        M.load(obj,before);assert digest_before(M,before,obj) and q.phash()==qhash and not ao.state and not vo.state
    q.cpu();v.cpu();del data,packed,obj,q,v,ao,vo;torch.cuda.empty_cache();os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']=''
    # Import and install actual transport without network; validate real guard
    # loader using source protocol, not a fake successful JSON receipt.
    def module(name,path):
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[name]=m;spec.loader.exec_module(m);return m
    T.save(HERE/'protocol.json',p)
    trans=module('_t660_transport_preflight',HERE/'transport.py');client=trans.Prior.client()
    assert Path(trans.Prior.A.OLD.T.__file__).resolve()==ROOT/'stage/experiments/t377_full_human_observation_transfer/transport.py'
    affinity=module('_t660_affinity_preflight',HERE/'affinity_guard.py');config,df,sf=affinity.configuration(HERE)
    assert config['out']==str(OUT) and df==HERE/'DRIVER_STARTED.json'
    T.setup(dict(p,out=str(OUT/'fixture'),arm='fixture'))
    assert R.Runtime.guard.__globals__['verify'] is T.verify and O_worker(T) is T.N.worker
    for f in HERE.glob('*.py'):ast.parse(f.read_text())
    files=set(HERE.glob('*.py'))|{contract,DOC/'PLAN.md',DOC/'PRIMARY_REVIEW.md',ROOT/'stage/runs/t656_qualified_recovery_pg/protocol.json'}
    files.update(Path(row['source_path']) for row in refs['reference_rows'])
    files.update(Path(j['exact_snapshot']) for j in p['evaluation_jobs'])
    files.add(Path(initial['path']))
    for m in list(sys.modules.values()):
        f=getattr(m,'__file__',None)
        if f and str(f).startswith(str(ROOT)) and str(f).endswith('.py'):files.add(Path(f).resolve())
    p['inputs']={str(f):T.sha(f) for f in files};T.save(HERE/'protocol.json',p)
    T.save(DOC/'ENTRY_PREFLIGHT.json',dict(state='PASS_ZERO_NATIVE_ZERO_OPTIMIZER',actual_transport_client_install=True,
         actual_guard_configuration_loader=True,actual_pool_worker_bound=True,new_native=0,new_optimizer=0,network_calls=0))
    T.save(DOC/'PREFLIGHT.json',dict(state='PASS_ZERO_NATIVE_ZERO_OPTIMIZER',references=387,unique_task_weighting=True,
         actual_GPU_mean_and_tail_gradients=reports,full_mature_Actor_Value_Adam_rollback=True,initial_value_exact_zero=True,
         new_native=0,new_optimizer=0,new_Actor=0,new_Critic=0,all_source_bytes_prepared_offline=True,
         worst_global_bytes=R.used(ROOT/'stage/runs')+p['max_bytes']))
    T.save(DOC/'BUDGET.json',{k:p[k] for k in ['night_max_physics','night_max_commands','night_main_seconds','Actor_each_cap','Value_each_cap',
        'max_bytes','global_bytes','absolute_all_stop','absolute_native_stop','absolute_learning_stop','backup_seconds','source_seconds',
        'bc_template','rl_template','profile_template','coverage_template','coverage_batches']})
    print(json.dumps(dict(state='PASS_ZERO_NATIVE_ZERO_OPTIMIZER',gradients=reports,night_physics=p['night_max_physics'],Actor_each=p['Actor_each_cap'],Value_each=p['Value_each_cap'])))

def digest_before(M,before,obj):return M.digest(before)==M.digest(M.cpu_state(obj))
def O_worker(T):return T.R.N.Pool.__init__.__globals__['worker']
if __name__=='__main__':main()

import t651_native as Base

def worker(pipe,index,p,counts):

    os.sched_setaffinity=pin;G.T.Session=Base.Session
    G.B.native_setup=lambda folder,pc:Base.C.consistent_reset.setup(F,folder,pc,Base.C.CANONICAL_SETUP)

def inspect(p,a,row):

    assert np.array_equal(a['actions'],np.clip(a['raw_actions'],-1,1).astype(np.float32))
    assert np.array_equal(a['states'][1:,117:119],a['actions'][:-1])
    F.M.audit_full_history(p,row,a)
    assert all(L.digest(v)==row['array_hashes'][key] for key,v in a.items())
    assert int(a['native_counts'].sum())==row['physics']

"""Bounded child: full histories, fresh joint blocks, exact rollback and audit."""
from pathlib import Path
import copy,fcntl,gzip,json,os,sys,time,traceback
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3];HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=ROOT/'stage/runs/t660_joint_night_relay';DOC=ROOT/'stage/docs/overnight_20261119'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'stage/experiments/t645_iterative_recovery_relay'));import control as Resource
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'stage/experiments/t654_verified_deviation_recovery'));import t654_runtime as Prior
import learning as M
import native as N
R,O,torch,np=Prior.R,Prior.O,Prior.torch,Prior.np
read,save,sha,digest=Prior.read,Prior.save,Prior.sha,Prior.digest

def plan():
    root=read(HERE/'protocol.json');child=read(OUT/sys.argv[2]/'protocol.json')
    assert child['_root_sha256']==sha(OUT/'protocol.json')
    return dict(root,**child,out=str(OUT/sys.argv[2]))

def verify(p,*args):
    root=read(OUT/'protocol.json')
    assert root['authorization_approved'] and time.time()<root['absolute_all_stop']
    assert sha(HERE/'protocol.json')==sha(OUT/'protocol.json')
    assert R.used(OUT)<=root['max_bytes'] and R.used(Path(p['out']))<=p['child_bytes']
    assert R.used(ROOT/'stage/runs')-R.used(OUT)+root['max_bytes']<root['global_bytes']
    assert R.D.B.shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free>=40*2**30
    Resource.resources()
    h=read(DOC/'AFFINITY_GUARD.json');assert h['state']=='ACTIVE_RESOURCE_ONLY' and Path('/proc',str(h['pid'])).exists()
    for f,h in root['inputs'].items():assert sha(f)==h,f

def setup(p):
    folder=Path(p['out']);Prior.OUT,Prior.DOC,Prior.HERE,Prior.verify=folder,DOC/p['arm'],HERE,verify
    Prior.setup(p);R.N.worker=N.worker;R.N.inspect=O.N.inspect=N.inspect
    O.OUT=folder;R.OUT=folder;R.verify=verify;R.safe=Prior.safe
    N.P.frozen=N.L.frozen

def pool(rt):
    folder=Path(rt.p['out']);f=folder/'worker_generations.json';old=read(f) if f.exists() else []
    rt.pool=R.N.Pool(dict(rt.p,out=str(folder),native_stop_epoch=rt.deadline),rt.counts,rt.guard)
    new=read(f);save(f,old+new)
    if old:rt.commands+=6

def close(rt):
    if rt.pool:rt.pool.close();rt.pool=None

def gpu(p,folder):
    R.gpu_guard();os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']='0';os.environ['CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG']=':4096:8'
    lock=(ROOT/'stage/runs/.stage_gpu.lock').open('a+b');fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB);return lock

def free_gpu(lock,objects):
    for obj in objects:
        obj[0].cpu();obj[1].cpu()
    torch.cuda.empty_cache();fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN);lock.close();os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']=''

def event(folder,who,rnd):
    def emit(kind,stage,k):
        with (folder/'optimizer_calls.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps([who,rnd,kind,stage,k])+'\n')
    return emit

def fit_block(p,folder,rnd,before,groups,guard):
    lock=gpu(p,folder);objects=[]
    try:
        obj=M.make(p,'cuda');shadow=M.make(p,'cuda');objects=[obj,shadow]
        if before is not None:M.load(obj,M.read_state(before));M.load(shadow,M.read_state(before))
        initial=M.cpu_state(obj);assert digest(initial)==digest(M.cpu_state(shadow))
        start=M.save_state(folder/f'start_{rnd:02d}.pt.gz',initial,p['state_bytes'])
        refs=M.references(p,obj[0],guard)
        u=M.fit(obj,refs,groups,p,guard,event(folder,'live',rnd))
        v=M.fit(shadow,refs,groups,p,guard,event(folder,'shadow',rnd))
        assert u==v and digest(M.state(obj))==digest(M.state(shadow))
        after=M.cpu_state(obj);proposal=M.export(obj,p,folder/f'proposal_{rnd:02d}.pt.gz')
        full=M.save_state(folder/f'trained_{rnd:02d}.pt.gz',after,p['state_bytes'])
        M.load(obj,initial);M.load(shadow,initial)
        assert digest(M.cpu_state(obj))==digest(initial)==digest(M.cpu_state(shadow))
        del refs
        return dict(round=rnd,start=start,trained=full,update=u,proposal=proposal,rollback_verified=True)
    finally:free_gpu(lock,objects)

def main():
    p=plan();verify(p);setup(p);folder=Path(p['out']);R.E.L.install_stop_handlers()
    lock=(ROOT/'stage/runs/.stage_writer.lock').open('a+b');fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    save(folder/'science_started.json',dict(pid=os.getpid(),epoch=time.time()))
    rt=O.Runtime(p);error=None;rounds=[];best=None;current=p['initial'];before=None;rejects=0;full_done=False
    previous_screen_ids=set(p['original_screen_success_ids']);stop='FIXED_ROUNDS_COMPLETE';live=value=0
    try:
        for rnd in range(p['rounds']):
            # Complete next block reserve; time denial is a normal bounded
            # stop, not an invitation to shorten evaluation or reuse batches.
            if time.time()+p['block_science_reserve_seconds']+p['learning_seconds']>=min(rt.deadline,p['absolute_learning_stop']):
                stop='NEXT_COMPLETE_BLOCK_TIME_ADMISSION_DENIED';break
            groups=[];training_rows=[]
            if p['arm'].startswith('ppo'):
                pool(rt)
                jobs=[j for j in p['training_jobs'] for unused in range(p['episodes_per_task'])]
                seeds=[[p['night_seed'],p['arm_index'],rnd,i] for i in range(len(jobs))]
                vv=rt.request(jobs,current,f'fresh_{rnd:02d}',True,seeds=seeds)
                rt.request(jobs,current,f'exact_fresh_{rnd:02d}',False,[r for a,r in vv],seeds=seeds)
                training_rows=[r for a,r in vv]
                groups=[(j['id'],[(a,r) for a,r in vv if r['job_id']==j['id']]) for j in p['training_jobs']]
                close(rt)
            start=time.time()
            def guard():
                rt.guard();assert time.time()<min(start+p['learning_seconds'],p['absolute_learning_stop'])-5;R.gpu_guard()
            record=fit_block(p,folder,rnd,before,groups,guard)
            live+=record['update']['Actor_Adam'];value+=record['update']['Value_Adam']
            record['training_rows']=training_rows
            pool(rt)
            vv=rt.request(p['screen_jobs'],record['proposal'],f'screen_{rnd:02d}',False)
            screen=[r for a,r in vv];ids={r['job_id'] for r in screen if Prior.safe(r)}
            keys=[r for r in screen if r['job_id'] in p['key_ids']]
            rt.request([r['request']['job'] for r in keys],record['proposal'],f'exact_key_{rnd:02d}',True,keys)
            native_ok=previous_screen_ids<=ids
            record.update(screen=screen,lost_screen_ids=sorted(previous_screen_ids-ids),full407=None,
                          research_state_kept=False,retained_all384_verified=False)
            # At most one full407 per arm, only with a screen-safe acquisition.
            gain=ids-set(p['before_success_ids'])
            if native_ok and gain and not full_done:
                if time.time()+p['full_evaluation_reserve_seconds']<rt.deadline:
                    full_done=True;by={r['job_id']:r for r in screen}
                    rest=[j for j in p['evaluation_jobs'] if j['id'] not in by]
                    zz=rt.request(rest,record['proposal'],f'rest407_{rnd:02d}',False)
                    by.update({r['job_id']:r for a,r in zz});safe_ids={k for k,r in by.items() if Prior.safe(r)}
                    lost=sorted(set(p['before_success_ids'])-safe_ids)
                    accepted=not lost and bool(safe_ids-set(p['before_success_ids']))
                    record['full407']=dict(success=len(safe_ids),success_ids=sorted(safe_ids),lost_prior=lost,
                        gained_prior=sorted(safe_ids-set(p['before_success_ids'])),accepted=accepted,
                        all387=set(p['required387_ids'])<=safe_ids)
                    native_ok=native_ok and not lost
                    if accepted:best=dict(model=record['proposal'],full407=record['full407']);record['retained_all384_verified']=True
                else:record['full407_not_run']='Complete reserved wall time unavailable; null'
            close(rt)
            if native_ok:
                before=record['trained'];current=record['proposal'];previous_screen_ids|=ids
                rejects=0;record['research_state_kept']=True
            else:rejects+=1
            record['consecutive_native_rejections']=rejects;rounds.append(record);save(folder/'ROUNDS.json',rounds)
            save(folder/'progress.json',dict(rounds=len(rounds),Actor_live=live,Value_live=value,physics=sum(rt.counts),commands=rt.commands))
            if rejects>=2:stop='TWO_CONSECUTIVE_NATIVE_REJECTIONS_NEXT_BRANCH';break
    except BaseException:error=traceback.format_exc();save(folder/'failure.json',dict(error=error,no_restart=True,raw_preserved=True))
    finally:
        close(rt);rt.commands+=3
        save(folder/'summary.json',dict(state='FAILED' if error else 'COMPLETE',pid=os.getpid(),error=error,
            physics=sum(rt.counts),commands=rt.commands,elapsed_s=time.time()-rt.start,rounds=rounds,stop_reason=stop,
            live_Actor=live,live_Value=value,best=best,retained=best['model'] if best else p['initial'],
            full407=best['full407'] if best else None,research_model=current,no_runtime_teacher_or_router=True))
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN);lock.close()
    assert error is None,error

def audit():
    p=plan();verify(p);setup(p);folder=Path(p['out']);s=read(folder/'summary.json')
    assert s['state']=='COMPLETE' and not Path('/proc',str(s['pid'])).exists()
    generations=read(folder/'worker_generations.json') if (folder/'worker_generations.json').exists() else []
    assert all(not Path('/proc',str(pid)).exists() for g in generations for pid in [g['parent'],*g['workers']])
    rows=[json.loads(x) for x in gzip.decompress((folder/'cases.jsonl.gz').read_bytes()).decode().splitlines()] if (folder/'cases.jsonl.gz').exists() else []
    by={r['path']:r for r in rows};assert len(by)==len(rows)
    for row in rows:
        assert sha(row['path'])==row['sha256'];a=R.E.N.S.arrays(row['path'])
        if row['full']:N.inspect(p,a,row)
        else:assert all(digest(v)==row['array_hashes'][key] for key,v in a.items())
        if row.get('exact'):
            ref=by[row['reference_path']];assert row['array_hashes']==ref['array_hashes'] and row['integration_sha256']==ref['integration_sha256']
    assert sum(r['physics'] for r in rows)==s['physics']<=p['max_physics']
    assert s['commands']==len(rows)+6+6*max(0,len(generations)-1)<=p['max_commands']
    start=time.time();last=[0.]
    def guard():
        assert time.time()<min(start+p['audit_seconds']-10,p['absolute_all_stop']-60)
        if time.time()-last[0]>5:verify(p);R.gpu_guard();last[0]=time.time()
    counts_a=counts_v=0
    for record in s['rounds']:
        gl=gpu(p,folder);obj=M.make(p,'cuda')
        try:
            M.load(obj,M.read_state(record['start']));refs=M.references(p,obj[0],guard)
            training=record['training_rows'];groups=[(j['id'],[(R.E.N.S.arrays(r['path']),r) for r in training if r['job_id']==j['id']]) for j in p['training_jobs']] if training else []
            result=M.fit(obj,refs,groups,p,guard,event(folder,'independent_history',record['round']))
            assert result==record['update'] and digest(M.cpu_state(obj))==record['trained']['state_hash']
            assert obj[0].phash()==record['proposal']['policy_hash']
            M.load(obj,M.read_state(record['start']));assert digest(M.cpu_state(obj))==record['start']['state_hash']
            counts_a+=result['Actor_Adam'];counts_v+=result['Value_Adam'];del refs
        finally:free_gpu(gl,[obj])
    assert counts_a==s['live_Actor'] and counts_v==s['live_Value']
    calls=[json.loads(v) for v in (folder/'optimizer_calls.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()] if s['rounds'] else []
    for record in s['rounds']:
        for who in ['live','shadow','independent_history']:
            for kind,expected in [('actor',record['update']['Actor_Adam']),('value',record['update']['Value_Adam'])]:
                actual=[v[3:] for v in calls if v[:3]==[who,record['round'],kind]]
                assert actual==[[stage,k] for k in range(expected) for stage in ['BEFORE','AFTER']]
    save(folder/'audit.json',dict(state='PASS',all_complete_history_and_density=True,all_live_shadow_independent_equal=True,
        independent_Actor=counts_a,independent_Value=counts_v,full_Actor_Value_Adam_rollback=True,new_native=0))

def frozen_main():
    p=plan();verify(p);setup(p);folder=Path(p['out']);R.E.L.install_stop_handlers()
    lock=(ROOT/'stage/runs/.stage_writer.lock').open('a+b');fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    save(folder/'science_started.json',dict(pid=os.getpid(),epoch=time.time()));rt=O.Runtime(p);error=None
    try:
        pool(rt)
        jobs=p['frozen_jobs'];seeds=p.get('frozen_seeds')
        vv=rt.request(jobs,p['initial'],'frozen_fresh',p['frozen_full'],seeds=seeds)
        rt.request(jobs,p['initial'],'frozen_exact',False,[r for a,r in vv],seeds=seeds)
    except BaseException:error=traceback.format_exc();save(folder/'failure.json',dict(error=error,raw_preserved=True))
    finally:
        close(rt);rt.commands+=3
        fresh=[r for r in rt.rows if r['role']=='frozen_fresh']
        save(folder/'summary.json',dict(state='FAILED' if error else 'COMPLETE',pid=os.getpid(),error=error,
            physics=sum(rt.counts),commands=rt.commands,elapsed_s=time.time()-rt.start,live_Actor=0,live_Value=0,
            measured=len(fresh),safe=sum(Prior.safe(r) for r in fresh),rows=fresh,model=p['initial'],
            kind=p['kind'],stochastic_coverage_is_not_deterministic_acceptance=seeds is not None))
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN);lock.close()
    assert error is None,error

def frozen_audit():
    p=plan();verify(p);setup(p);folder=Path(p['out']);s=read(folder/'summary.json')
    assert s['state']=='COMPLETE' and not Path('/proc',str(s['pid'])).exists()
    for g in read(folder/'worker_generations.json'):assert all(not Path('/proc',str(pid)).exists() for pid in [g['parent'],*g['workers']])
    rows=[json.loads(x) for x in gzip.decompress((folder/'cases.jsonl.gz').read_bytes()).decode().splitlines()];by={r['path']:r for r in rows}
    assert len(rows)==len(by)==2*len(p['frozen_jobs'])
    for row in rows:
        assert sha(row['path'])==row['sha256'];a=R.E.N.S.arrays(row['path'])
        if row['full']:N.inspect(p,a,row)
        else:assert all(digest(v)==row['array_hashes'][key] for key,v in a.items())
        if row.get('exact'):
            ref=by[row['reference_path']];assert ref['array_hashes']==row['array_hashes'] and ref['integration_sha256']==row['integration_sha256']
        assert row['loaded_model_sha256']==p['initial']['sha256']
    assert sum(r['physics'] for r in rows)==s['physics'] and len(rows)+6==s['commands']
    assert s['physics']<=p['max_physics'] and s['commands']<=p['max_commands']
    save(folder/'audit.json',dict(state='PASS',all_exact_arrays_and_full_histories_checked=True,
         independent_Actor=0,independent_Value=0,new_native=0,new_optimizer=0))

if __name__=='__main__':{'main':main,'audit':audit,'frozen_main':frozen_main,'frozen_audit':frozen_audit}[sys.argv[1]]()

"""Clean unique-ID BC and fresh original-start PPO; no learned Q guidance."""
from pathlib import Path
import copy
import gzip
import io
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'stage/experiments/t654_verified_deviation_recovery'))
import t654_learning as Base
L,P,E,torch,np=Base.L,Base.P,Base.E,Base.torch,Base.np
read,save,sha,digest=Base.read,Base.save,Base.sha,Base.digest
location=Base.location


class Value(torch.nn.Module):
    """Frozen-causal-feature baseline; no action input or actor gradient."""
    def __init__(self,seed):
        super().__init__()
        with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]):
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            self.net=torch.nn.Sequential(torch.nn.Linear(184,64),torch.nn.Tanh(),torch.nn.Linear(64,1)).double()
            torch.nn.init.zeros_(self.net[-1].weight);torch.nn.init.zeros_(self.net[-1].bias)
    def forward(self,f):return self.net(f.detach())[...,0]


def make(p,device):
    torch.set_num_threads(1);torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    q=L.frozen(p,p['initial']['path']).to(device).train().requires_grad_(False)
    q.drive_adapter.requires_grad_(True);q.steer_adapter.requires_grad_(True)
    variables=[v for v in q.parameters() if v.requires_grad]
    assert sum(v.numel() for v in variables)==11906
    v=Value(p['baseline_seed']).to(device)
    ao=torch.optim.Adam(variables,lr=p['fit_lr'],foreach=False,fused=False)
    vo=torch.optim.Adam(v.parameters(),lr=p['baseline_lr'],foreach=False,fused=False)
    return q,v,ao,vo


def state(obj):
    q,v,ao,vo=obj
    return copy.deepcopy(dict(actor=q.state_dict(),value=v.state_dict(),actor_opt=ao.state_dict(),value_opt=vo.state_dict()))


def load(obj,s):
    for target,key in zip(obj,['actor','value','actor_opt','value_opt']):target.load_state_dict(s[key])


def cpu_state(obj):
    def cpu(x):
        if torch.is_tensor(x):return x.detach().cpu().clone()
        if isinstance(x,dict):return {k:cpu(v) for k,v in x.items()}
        if isinstance(x,list):return [cpu(v) for v in x]
        if isinstance(x,tuple):return tuple(cpu(v) for v in x)
        return x
    return cpu(state(obj))


def features(q,a,key,source_sha):
    device=next(q.parameters()).device
    with torch.no_grad():
        x=torch.tensor(a['states'],device=device)
        n=q.normalized(x);h,_=q.core(q.encoder(n)[:,None]);h=h[:,0]
        g=dict(id=key,f=torch.cat([h,n],-1),logits=q.head(h),target=torch.tensor(a['actions'],device=device).double(),
               source_sha256=source_sha)
        assert float((location(q,g)-q.sequence(x)).abs().max())<1e-10
    return g


def references(p,q,guard):
    contract=read(p['reference_contract'])
    assert len(contract['reference_rows'])==387
    answer=[]
    for row in contract['reference_rows']:
        guard();assert sha(row['source_path'])==row['sha256']
        a=E.N.S.arrays(row['source_path'])
        assert not a['ownership'].any() and not a['stochastic'].any() and a['end_flags'][-1,1] and not a['end_flags'][:-1].any()
        answer.append(features(q,a,row['task_id'],row['sha256']))
    assert len({g['id'] for g in answer})==387
    return answer


def pack(groups):
    lengths=[len(g['f']) for g in groups]
    return dict(f=torch.cat([g['f'] for g in groups]),logits=torch.cat([g['logits'] for g in groups]),
                target=torch.cat([g['target'] for g in groups]),lengths=lengths,ids=[g['id'] for g in groups])


def retention(q,data,tail=False):
    err=P.action_loss(location(q,data),data['target']).mean(-1)/.2**2
    episodes=[]
    for e in err.split(data['lengths']):
        term=e.mean()
        if tail:term=.5*term+.5*e.topk(max(1,(len(e)+4)//5)).values.mean()
        episodes.append(term)
    losses=torch.stack(episodes)
    result=losses.mean()
    if tail:result=.5*result+.5*losses.topk(max(1,(len(losses)+9)//10)).values.mean()
    return result,losses


def outcome(row):
    assert row['complete'] and not row['administrative_censor']
    return float(row['success'] and not row['collision'] and
                 (not ('fullfield_start_pose' in row['request']['job']) or not row.get('field_boundary',False)))


def fresh_items(obj,groups,p):
    q,v,ao,vo=obj;items=[]
    for key,values in groups:
        episodes=[]
        assert len(values)==p['episodes_per_task']
        for a,row in values:
            assert not a['ownership'].any() and a['stochastic'].all() and row['seed'] is not None
            assert row['policy_hash']==q.phash()
            g=features(q,a,key,row['sha256']);device=g['f'].device
            with torch.no_grad():
                loc=location(q,g);raw=torch.tensor(a['raw_actions'],device=device);atom=torch.tensor(a['atom'],device=device)
                old=torch.tensor(a['logp'],device=device)
                density=P.L.density(loc,raw,atom,p['raw_sigma'])
                assert float((density-old).abs().max())<1e-9
                assert float((loc-torch.tensor(a['locations'],device=device)).abs().max())<1e-10
                baseline=v(g['f']).detach().clone()
                target=loc.new_full((len(loc),),outcome(row))
            episodes.append(dict(**g,raw=raw,atom=atom,old=old,initial=loc.detach().clone(),
                                 baseline=baseline,target_value=target,adv=(target-baseline).detach()))
        items.append(episodes)
    return items


def pg_loss(q,episodes,p):
    loss=next(q.parameters()).new_zeros(())
    for g in episodes:
        ratio=(P.L.density(location(q,g),g['raw'],g['atom'],p['raw_sigma'])-g['old']).exp()
        loss-=torch.minimum(ratio*g['adv'],ratio.clamp(1-p['ratio_clip'],1+p['ratio_clip'])*g['adv']).sum()/(len(episodes)*p['score_scale'])
    return loss


def fit(obj,refs,groups,p,guard,event):
    q,v,ao,vo=obj;fixed=L.fixed_hash(q);tail=p['arm'].endswith('tail');rl=p['arm'].startswith('ppo')
    keep=pack(refs);items=fresh_items(obj,groups,p) if rl else []
    frozen_adv=[digest([g['baseline'] for g in episodes]) for episodes in items]
    trace=[];steps=p['ppo_epochs'] if rl else p['bc_steps']
    for k in range(steps):
        guard();before=state(obj);ao.zero_grad(set_to_none=True);pg=0.
        if rl:
            for episodes in items:
                loss=pg_loss(q,episodes,p)/len(items);loss.backward();pg+=float(loss.detach())
        keep_loss,losses=retention(q,keep,tail)
        ((p['replay_weight'] if rl else 1.)*keep_loss).backward()
        variables=[x for x in q.parameters() if x.requires_grad]
        norm=float(torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(variables,1.,error_if_nonfinite=True))
        event('actor','BEFORE',k);ao.step();event('actor','AFTER',k)
        assert all(torch.isfinite(x).all() for x in variables) and L.fixed_hash(q)==fixed
        kl=[]
        with torch.no_grad():
            for episodes in items:
                kl.append(sum(float((.5*((location(q,g)-g['initial'])/.2).square().sum(-1)).mean()) for g in episodes)/len(episodes))
        okay=not kl or max(kl)<=p['max_task_latent_KL']
        if not okay:load(obj,before)
        trace.append(dict(step=k,pg=pg,keep=float(keep_loss.detach()),worst_task_loss=float(losses.max().detach()),norm=norm,kl=kl,accepted=okay))
        if not okay:break
    # Value from BEFORE the block generated every advantage. Current data fit
    # is exclusively for the NEXT fresh block; it never guides action choice.
    value_trace=[]
    if rl:
        assert frozen_adv==[digest([g['baseline'] for g in episodes]) for episodes in items]
        f=torch.cat([g['f'] for episodes in items for g in episodes]);targets=torch.cat([g['target_value'] for episodes in items for g in episodes])
        weights=torch.cat([g['old'].new_full((len(g['old']),),1/(len(items)*len(episodes)*len(g['old']))) for episodes in items for g in episodes])
        for k in range(p['value_steps']):
            guard();vo.zero_grad(set_to_none=True);loss=((v(f)-targets).square()*weights).sum();loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(v.parameters(),1.,error_if_nonfinite=True)
            event('value','BEFORE',k);vo.step();event('value','AFTER',k)
            value_trace.append(float(loss.detach()))
    return dict(Actor_Adam=len(trace),Value_Adam=len(value_trace),trace=trace,value_trace=value_trace,
                fresh_original_start_block=rl,previous_block_value_used=True,no_Q_guidance=True,
                unique_reference_count=387,tail_loss=tail,trainable_Actor_parameters=11906,
                backbone_hash=fixed,no_deterministic_success_guarantee=True)


def export(obj,p,path):
    s=cpu_state(obj);old=P.checkpoint(p['initial']['path'])['joint_state']
    # Legacy Value is retained only to keep the established deploy loader
    # format. The new baseline and both active optimizers are separate state.
    joint=dict(actor=s['actor'],actor_opt=s['actor_opt'],value=old['value'],value_opt=old['value_opt'])
    buf=io.BytesIO();torch.save(dict(joint_state=joint,policy_hash=obj[0].phash(),joint_hash=digest(joint),
         architecture='T501_single120_64carry_two_neural_command_residuals',single_actor=True,teacher_at_deployment=False),buf)
    blob=gzip.compress(buf.getvalue(),mtime=0);assert len(blob)<=p['model_bytes']
    with Path(path).open('xb') as f:f.write(blob)
    return dict(path=str(path),sha256=sha(path),policy_hash=obj[0].phash(),joint_hash=digest(joint),bytes=len(blob))


def save_state(path,s,limit):
    buf=io.BytesIO();torch.save(s,buf);blob=gzip.compress(buf.getvalue(),mtime=0);assert len(blob)<=limit
    with Path(path).open('xb') as f:f.write(blob)
    return dict(path=str(path),sha256=sha(path),state_hash=digest(s),bytes=len(blob))


def read_state(row):
    assert sha(row['path'])==row['sha256']
    state=torch.load(io.BytesIO(gzip.decompress(Path(row['path']).read_bytes())),map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
    assert digest(state)==row['state_hash'];return state

"""Post-science full raw RAM archives, no deletion and no science networking."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import importlib.util
import signal
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT = ROOT/'stage/runs/t660_joint_night_relay'
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT/'stage/experiments/t654_verified_deviation_recovery'))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('_t659r_archive_prior', ROOT/'stage/experiments/t654_verified_deviation_recovery/transport.py')
Prior = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(Prior)


def main():
    p = json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text())
    deadline = min(time.time()+p['backup_seconds']-5, p['absolute_all_stop']-p['source_seconds']-20)
    def stopped():
        sealed = json.loads((OUT/'SEALED.json').read_text())
        assert sealed['all_scientific_processes_stopped']
        assert all(not Path('/proc', str(pid)).exists() for pid in sealed['scientific_pids'])
    stopped()
    Prior.A.stopped = stopped
    def timeout(*args):
        raise TimeoutError('T660 bounded post-science transport')
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, timeout)
    signal.alarm(max(1, int(deadline-time.time())))
    client = Prior.client()
    original_write = client.B.write
    def write(path, value):
        if Path(path).name.startswith('source_manifest_T660_'):
            value = dict(value, scope='Ended bounded offline T660 joint BC and fresh original-start RL relay; no universal nonforgetting claim')
        return original_write(path, value)
    client.B.write = write
    release = client.B.api('GET', 'releases/tags/stage-eight-only-2026-11-11')
    files = sorted(f for folder in [OUT] for f in folder.rglob('*') if f.is_file() and f.name not in ['driver.log','affinity.log']
                   and f.suffix not in ['.pyc','.lock','.partial'])
    batches, batch, n = [], [], 0
    for file in files:
        if batch and n+file.stat().st_size > 32*2**20:
            batches.append(batch)
            batch, n = [], 0
        batch.append(file)
        n += file.stat().st_size
    if batch:
        batches.append(batch)
    receipts = [Prior.A.archive(f'T660_raw_{i}', group, release, deadline, client) for i, group in enumerate(batches)]
    client.B.write(ROOT/'stage/docs/long_distance_20261101/release_receipt_T660.json',
        dict(state='FULL_REMOTE_READBACK_AND_EVERY_MEMBER_SHA_VERIFIED', group='T660',
             child_receipts=[r['group'] for r in receipts], bytes=sum(r['bytes'] for r in receipts), files_deleted=0))
    signal.alarm(0)
    print('T660_FULL_RAW_REMOTE_VERIFIED')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Authorization, bounded registration, resource admission and one launch."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,os,subprocess,sys,time
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3];HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=ROOT/'stage/runs/t660_joint_night_relay';DOC=ROOT/'stage/docs/overnight_20261119'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'stage/experiments/t645_iterative_recovery_relay'));import control as Resource
def read(f):return json.loads(Path(f).read_text())
def save(f,v):Path(f).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
def sha(f):return hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def register():
    assert not OUT.exists();p=read(HERE/'protocol.json');a=read(DOC/'AUTHORIZATION.json')
    assert a['approved'] and not p['authorization_approved']
    for key in ['night_max_physics','night_max_commands','night_main_seconds','Actor_each_cap','Value_each_cap','max_bytes','global_bytes','absolute_all_stop']:
        assert a[key]==p[key],key
    assert read(DOC/'PREFLIGHT.json')['state']=='PASS_ZERO_NATIVE_ZERO_OPTIMIZER'
    assert read(DOC/'ENTRY_PREFLIGHT.json')['state']=='PASS_ZERO_NATIVE_ZERO_OPTIMIZER'
    for f,h in p['inputs'].items():assert sha(f)==h,f
    save(DOC/'RESOURCE_PREFLIGHT.json',Resource.resources())
    assert time.time()+p['finalization_seconds']+3600<p['absolute_learning_stop']
    p.update(authorization_approved=True,registration_epoch=time.time())
    p['inputs'].update({str(DOC/'AUTHORIZATION.json'):sha(DOC/'AUTHORIZATION.json'),str(DOC/'PREFLIGHT.json'):sha(DOC/'PREFLIGHT.json'),str(DOC/'ENTRY_PREFLIGHT.json'):sha(DOC/'ENTRY_PREFLIGHT.json')})
    OUT.mkdir();save(HERE/'protocol.json',p);save(OUT/'protocol.json',p)
    save(DOC/'REGISTERED.json',dict(state='REGISTERED_NOT_LAUNCHED',epoch=p['registration_epoch'],all_stop=p['absolute_all_stop']))
    print('T660_REGISTERED_NOT_LAUNCHED',p['absolute_all_stop'])

def launch():
    p=read(OUT/'protocol.json');assert p['authorization_approved'] and not (OUT/'launch.json').exists()
    Resource.resources();receipt=read(ROOT/'stage/runs/t224_archive/latest_source_sync_receipt.json')
    assert receipt['root_tree']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
    left=int(p['absolute_all_stop']-time.time()-2);assert left>3600
    cmd=['systemd-run','--user','--unit=stage-t660','--collect','--property=Type=exec',
        '--property=CPUQuota=400%','--property=CPUWeight=10','--property=Nice=19','--property=AllowedCPUs=8 10 12 14',
        '--property=MemoryMax=4G','--property=MemorySwapMax=0','--property=KillMode=control-group','--property=TimeoutStopSec=5',
        f'--property=RuntimeMaxSec={left}',f'--property=WorkingDirectory={ROOT}',f'--property=StandardOutput=append:{OUT}/driver.log',
        '--property=StandardError=inherit','--setenv=CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=','systemd-inhibit','--what=sleep:idle','--mode=block',
        '--who=Stage T660','--why=Bounded offline joint learning multibranch relay',str(ROOT/'run_stage.sh'),str(HERE/'driver.py')]
    c=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True);assert c.returncode==0,c.stderr
    with (OUT/'launch.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(dict(epoch=time.time(),unit='stage-t660',source_remote=receipt['remote_commit'],absolute_all_stop=p['absolute_all_stop']),f,indent=2)
    print(c.stderr.strip())

if __name__=='__main__':{'register':register,'launch':launch}[sys.argv[1]]()
